The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[NPC]] located north of the [[Village|Village]], not far from the [[Mountain fort|Mountain Fort]].

==History==
From dialogue with the woodcutter we can gather that he was once rich and lived in a mansion, before giving it up to live a simpler life.

==Quests==
===A Nicer Axe===
{{PAGENAME}} asks you to bring him an iron axe. If you talk to him again you say that you have a nicer axe and give him {{Item|Axe I}}, he will reward you with the [[Cookery (Tech Tree)|Lasagna and Pasta recipes]].

=== The Golden Apple ===
After you finishing the [[Bishop]] quest "Hold the Ceremony", you have to talk to [[Bishop]] one week later to wrap it up. Then go to the [[The Dead Horse|Dead Horse]] which will trigger this quest.

Woodcutter meets you inside [[The Dead Horse]] and talks about a golden apple that he's willing to trade. To get one [[golden apple]] you must trade him: x24 [[Roof tile]] and x4 [[curtains]].
